note: Part (b) is a store-level injection: the loopback fixtures destination is unreachable from the sandboxed browser, so the controller-driven submit cannot reach it locally. The driver wrote two proposal records (status submitted / claimed) into the dead control plane's PGlite store and posted the 'reached' one once to the fixtures destination with a correctly minted approval code (simulating a submit that landed before the crash). Reconciliation after restart is the product's own code.
